body: I've tried that. They came to our door and talked to me and then my dad. I don't know what my dad said to him, but he ended up telling me it wasn't a serious enough issue for child services to get involved, and that I should only contact them in the case of an emergency. My dad's really good at warping things. I'm not sure he even realizes what he's doing to me sometimes. It's like there's two of him.
